payload.blocks: admitting plan 261123-0828 as a third lead, and the stale-worktree cleanup you ordered
payload.headline: Supervisor needs an unconfined hand: raise maxLeads to 3 and remove 7 landed-phase worktrees

parts.cause: The supervisor head runs confined (read-only .git and .fgos/config.yaml). Capacity now looks safe for a third lead: 24 cores, 18 GB RAM available, 119 GB disk free, 3 of 4 lanes free. You set maxLeads 2 at 12:38 after OOM kills.

options.does: Set supervisor.maxLeads: 3 in .fgos/config.yaml. For heads-stable-p13 and doors p01 p01b p02 p03 p1b p2e: git -C <wt> checkout -- . && git -C <wt> clean -fd, then fgos worktree remove <wt> --delivered-to origin/main --discard-ignored.
options.gain: 0828 admitted on my next wake; disk freed.
options.harm: OOM risk returns if the three leads plus units peak together.
options.label: Run both yourself

options.does: Open the unconfined supervisor session; I hand it the exact commands.
options.gain: Future confined chores also have a path.
options.harm: One more live session using RAM.
options.label: Start lead:SUPERVISOR

options.does: Do the worktree cleanup only; 0828 waits for heads-stable to finish after 21:06.
options.label: Keep maxLeads 2

parts.recommendation: Run both yourself. Worktrees p2f p2g p3b p3d are skipped: their phases are not landed and hold unit reports the lead must read first.

scope.allows: Setting supervisor.maxLeads to 3 for this project and removing the 7 listed landed-phase worktrees.
scope.forbids: Removing worktrees p2f p2g p3b p3d or the /tmp par scratch before the doors lead confirms them.

parts.what: Your two orders need writes my confinement refuses: .fgos/config.yaml (supervisor.maxLeads 2 -> 3) and git worktree removal (the repo .git is read-only to me). No lead:SUPERVISOR session is live to hand them to. The doors lead already has your order to start 2f, 2g, 3b-3e.
